Method of Attack: Supply chain attack via redirection to malicious Debian package repository
Installation of Bash information-stealing script and crond backdoor establishing reverse shell to C2 server
Creation of cron job to run stealer script on system startup
Impacted Systems: Debian-based Linux distributions including Ubuntu and Ubuntu-based forks
Attack Vector: Redirection from official download page freedownloadmanager.org to malicious domain deb.fdmpkg.org
Direct download of malicious Debian package
